name: Java Build Tools Bundle
description: Meta-feature bundling SDKMAN SDK manager with Maven and Gradle build tools for Java development workflows.

postInstallCheck.command: sh -c 'if [ -s "$HOME/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh"; fi; (mvn --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || gradle --version >/dev/null 2>&1) || echo "java build tools not found"'
postInstallCheck.description: Initialize SDKMAN (if present) and verify Maven or Gradle is available
